text:
Tristan Luneau had 14 NHL games to his name before this season. Now the 22-year-old is playing more than 20 minutes a night for Anaheim, and The Athletic put him on its list of eight rising players under 23. The Ducks' second-round pick from 2022 has 14 points in 26 games, four on the power play.

The five-on-five numbers back up the minutes. Anaheim takes about 55% of shot attempts and 54% of expected goals with him on the ice, and the team is far better with him out there than without him.

The scoring has been streaky in both directions. Early on he scored four goals on about two expected; lately he's gone six games without a point despite 2.7 expected points in that stretch, so the chances are still coming. Our range puts him around 43 points by season's end. What to watch: whether he keeps those minutes as the Ducks try to stay in the playoff race.
headline: Luneau's first full season, in big minutes
